items.question: 국고채 10년의 체결 건수와 체결대금 합계를 알려줘
items.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE p.PRODUCT_NAME = '국고채 10년'

runs.sql:
SELECT COUNT("FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"."EXEC_ID") AS "EXECUTION_COUNT",
       SUM("FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"."EXEC_AMOUNT") AS "TOTAL_EXECUTION_AMOUNT"
FROM "FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"
JOIN "FIN_DEMO"."ORDERS"
  ON "FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"."ORDER_ID" = "FIN_DEMO"."ORDERS"."ORDER_ID"
JOIN "FIN_DEMO"."PRODUCT"
  ON "FIN_DEMO"."ORDERS"."PRODUCT_CODE" = "FIN_DEMO"."PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_CODE"
WHERE "FIN_DEMO"."PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_NAME" = '국고채 10년'

SELECT COUNT("e"."EXEC_ID") AS "SETTLEMENT_COUNT",
       SUM("e"."EXEC_AMOUNT") AS "TOTAL_SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT"
FROM "FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS" "e"
JOIN "FIN_DEMO"."ORDERS" "o" ON "e"."ORDER_ID" = "o"."ORDER_ID"
JOIN "FIN_DEMO"."PRODUCT" "p" ON "o"."PRODUCT_CODE" = "p"."PRODUCT_CODE"
WHERE "p"."PRODUCT_NAME" = '국고채 10년'

SELECT COUNT("FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"."EXEC_ID") AS "EXECUTION_COUNT",
       SUM("FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"."EXEC_AMOUNT") AS "TOTAL_EXECUTION_AMOUNT"
FROM "FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"
JOIN "FIN_DEMO"."ORDERS"
  ON "FIN_DEMO"."EXECUTIONS"."ORDER_ID" = "FIN_DEMO"."ORDERS"."ORDER_ID"
JOIN "FIN_DEMO"."PRODUCT"
  ON "FIN_DEMO"."ORDERS"."PRODUCT_CODE" = "FIN_DEMO"."PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_CODE"
WHERE "FIN_DEMO"."PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_NAME" = '국고채 10년'
